title: VisionFaceEnrolRequest
description: vision.face-enrol-request@1: POST /api/v1/faces/enrol/:feature. `feature` is verify (1:1 verification of yourself), find (search your own uploads) or cast (an adult tagging named streams); each needs its own signed consent first, and cast also names the channel scope.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.
